card.name: Final piece of long drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long drug or disease name, such as the ending of amlodipine, nalmefene, lymphoma or gastroparesis, just before a bracket, comma or parenthesis. It also fires on a closing bracket after a cross-reference.
